aboutPage.title: About SuggestionsForYou
aboutPage.subtitle: We're on a mission to make every Indian purchase smarter. Compare prices across 5 retailers in real time.
aboutPage.storyP1: SuggestionsForYou started with a simple frustration: the same product could cost thousands of rupees more or less depending on which retailer's app you happened to open first — and there was no easy way to know which one was actually the best deal, or whether today's "sale" price was real.
aboutPage.storyP2: So we built a single place that watches 5 Indian retailers around the clock, tracks every price change, and uses that history to tell shoppers not just where to buy, but when. What began as a way to avoid overpaying on one laptop has grown into a platform tracking products for shoppers across the country, with our catalog expanding every week.
aboutPage.storyP3: We're not a retailer, and we never take a cut that costs you money — we earn a small commission from retailers when you buy, at no extra cost to you. Our only incentive is finding you the genuine best price.

values.title: Transparency
values.desc: Every price shown is the real, live price from the retailer — no hidden markups, no manufactured discounts.

values.title: Speed
values.desc: Prices refresh every 15 minutes across 5 retailers, so you're never acting on stale information.

values.title: Trust & Security
values.desc: Only verified, genuine sellers make the cut. No fake listings, no malicious redirects, ever.

values.title: Real Savings
values.desc: We measure success in rupees saved, not clicks earned — our AI recommends waiting when waiting pays off.
